audit.why: Both layers already read Neeko / Skill / Skill / Neeko / Gwen / Gwen / Skill, which is exactly the packet chart and exactly what the mirror set. Every row agrees between full and content, and each why-text argues the side it sits on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is named as the clock the whole matchup runs on, but its cooldown appears nowhere, so 'bait it, count it' has nothing to count.
audit.why: It is 22/21/20/19/18s — a very long window at rank 1 and the single largest free period Neeko gets. Skip 'n Slash is 13s at rank 1 but partially refunds when she connects, which is why the dash cannot be waited out the same way.
audit.corrected: 22s written into dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and mid; the E refund written into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.why: The page's core claim — Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable from outside it, so both Tangle-Barbs and the Pop Blossom commit blank — matches Riot's text and the kit's untargetable flag. It is the right thing to build the matchup around and it is already stated well.

audit.whatIsWrong: A Thousand Cuts heals her off every proc and neither layer's prose ever says so; anti-heal appears only as four words in the itemization line, attached to the wrong pronoun.
audit.why: _missing flags needs-antiheal for this matchup. Riot's passive text: bonus magic damage scaling with target health, and she heals for a portion of it against champions. Against a single-rotation burst champion, whether Grievous Wounds is on the board decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[5], late and report[8].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Skip 'n Slash's on-hit conversion is never mentioned — the page treats her E as a dash only.
audit.why: _missing flags onhit-itemization. Riot's text gives attack speed, bonus attack range and magic damage on-hit for a few seconds, with a partial cooldown refund on connecting. That is where her damage comes from in a trade, and it scales with attack speed rather than being answered by resists.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer refers to Gwen as 'he' and 'his' — tldr, ahead, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, report[4], report[8], report[11] and both dontsFull entries.
audit.why: Gwen is female; the page reads as boilerplate that was never edited for this matchup, which undercuts trust in everything else on it.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr and report[8].t, where a same-length replacement also let me add real content. The rest are listed in notes — most are long shared strings where a pronoun swap alone is a rewrite the band would measure.

edits.before: His mobility dodges your root — bait the dash with a clone, then land E on the landing spot.
edits.after: Her mist blanks your root — bait Hallowed Mist with a clone, then land E in the window it leaves.

edits.before: Untargetable from outside the mist — never burn damage into it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1, and outside it she cannot be targeted — bait it, count it, then go.

edits.before: That is Gwen’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash refunds its own cooldown when she connects.

edits.after: Track Hallowed Mist: 22s at rank 1, and from outside it she cannot be targeted at all. Every forward step waits for its downtime.

edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Stormsurge into Sorcerer's Shoes; then Shadowflame and Zhonya's into dive. Add anti-heal into A Thousand Cuts.

edits.before: First item is hers — Riftmaker components and her Q true-damage snips out-trade and out-sustain your single burst rotation.
edits.after: First item is hers — Riftmaker plus true-damage Snip Snip! out-trades you, and A Thousand Cuts heals it back unless you hold Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Your Q re-bloom waveclear lets you shove and roam, and Levels 4-5 you still pace her since pre-item Gwen is farm-focused — push and look mid/bot with disguise pressure rather than sitting in a losing 1v1. Then comes the problem: at 6 her Hallowed Mist (W) is the hard counter to your kit. When you channel Pop Blossom or fire E into the mist, she is simply untargetable, so your entire combo blanks and she walks out with her Q snips up. Never commit your ult onto a Gwen who still has mist; bait it first or you waste your whole rotation.
edits.after: Your Q re-bloom waveclear lets you shove and roam, and Levels 4-5 you still pace her since pre-item Gwen is farm-focused — push and look mid/bot with disguise pressure rather than sitting in a losing 1v1. Then comes the problem: at 6 her Hallowed Mist (W) is the hard counter to your kit. Wind up Pop Blossom or fire E into the mist and she is simply untargetable, so the whole combo blanks and she walks out with her snips up. Never ult a Gwen who still has mist; bait it, then you have 22 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: This is Gwen's game, not yours. She is a hard scaler — once Riftmaker and Nashor's online her true-damage Q snips shred you and her health stacking outlasts your single burst rotation, while mist denies you a clean engage every fight. Your job is to have already converted: a Level 6 pick or a First-item roam that gives your team a lead before she comes online. In the actual late teamfight, do not be the one who walks into mist to find her — flank the squishies with disguise, drop Pop Blossom on the clustered backline, and let your team absorb Gwen rather than dueling her.
edits.after: This is Gwen's game, not yours. She is a hard scaler — once Riftmaker and Nashor's are online her true-damage snips shred through MR, Skip 'n Slash turns every dash into on-hit damage, and A Thousand Cuts heals her back through your chip unless you carry Grievous Wounds. Your job is to have already converted: a Level 6 pick or a first-item roam that hands your team a lead. In the late fight, never be the one who walks into mist to find her — flank the squishies disguised, drop Pop Blossom on the clustered backline, and let your team absorb her.

notes: Gwen is referred to as 'he'/'his' in at least eight more full-layer strings: ahead, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.early, report[4].t, report[11].t, dontsFull[1].t and dontsFull[2].d. Those are long boilerplate strings shared across matchups, so a pronoun-only fix is a mechanical find/replace worth running outside the length band rather than eight separate edits. Second: the mirror raised an open question I could not close either — Needlework only slows, and Neeko's passive breaks on immobilizing crowd control, so it is unclear whether her R reveals a disguised Neeko. Riot's text does not define it and the kit's needsResearch is empty, so nothing on this page asserts it in either direction.
